implementation_summary: Established the consumer UI design system and application shell foundation with shared tokens, accessible composable primitives, simplified primary navigation, and responsive desktop/narrow behavior.

files_changed.change: Added design tokens and coherent global/primitives styling for layout, fields, actions, surfaces, banners, chips, disclosures, cards, and responsive behavior.
Added accessible composable UI primitives and adopted the status banner in the production shell.
Kept onboarding directly routable while limiting post-onboarding primary navigation to Ranked feed, Library, Sources, and Settings.
Added primitive accessibility/semantics tests and refreshed deterministic desktop and 390px browser evidence with overflow assertions.

verification.output: Vue and Node TypeScript checks completed successfully.
21 files and 147 tests passed, including axe coverage for the shell and new primitives.
Desktop and 390px evidence completed with keyboard navigation, same-origin privacy, and no narrow overflow.
Deterministic desktop/narrow primitive screenshots, Unicode wrapping, and hostile-text containment passed.
Go/integration, migrations, frontend lint/typecheck/tests/build/browser, PWA, and application build verification completed successfully.
